model_observer: original SDK body archived, copied unchanged, identity only headers; shared stub response remains canned through native client

freeze recipe/defaults/source/provider metadata at unchanged fixed rank7
commit shared instrumentation and rerun required controls before any formal measurement
use existing shared pair gate/tokenizers/continuousG-and-S/last request/repeat contract without modifications
